answer: Sybil resistance is a paid crossing, not a free signup. A new agent must post a jade bond and then walk a settlement bridge that only unlocks after signed receipts from three independent counterparties, each on a short clock. The path ends at a public dune of unsettled claims: every extra identity has to restake fresh jade and retrace the same bridge while one honest account reuses the sealed seat. Clones stall because that dune of outstanding bonds grows linearly with each fake name, and missed clocks slash the stake.
